name: Watercolor
visualIdentity: Translucent pigment washes, paper grain, soft bleeding edges, retained light paper, believable pigment overlap, and selective dry-brush detail. Supplemental reference, not a directly named source-collection style.
suitableUses: Explicit good fit: gentle narrative, mood, illustrated or cinematic sequences, product/editorial introductions, travel or nature data stories, recipes, and botanical explainers. Inferred: interactive HTML works for scroll-led stories and annotations when states remain readable.
limitations: Avoid uniform blur, repeated random stains, stains that obscure data, low-contrast labels, overcrowded notes, and extra ink colors. Adapt or omit chapter transitions when there are no meaningful chapters, causality is obscured, or a cut breaks a continuous shot or loop. Preserve wash boundaries and readable copy.
palette: Optional new-artwork suggestion: background #FBF6EB, foreground #3C4E58, accents #8EA8B6, #BF8E7A, #9BAE8E (five tokens; discrete, no gradient). Exact task, brand, reference, semantic-role, and asset colors take precedence; never recolor or expand approved colors. Suggested foreground on background contrast is 8.042; accents with foreground are decorative only (3.04–3.648). Check actual composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Develop washes or reveal layers gently; keep movement smooth and authored, with reading holds. Optional chapter handoffs or story progression may use scroll-scrubbed states in HTML and timed scene windows in video; coordinate copy and imagery, make reverse/direct seeking coherent, and retain final static or reduced-motion states. Do not add generic bounce or random stain changes.
audio: No fixed soundtrack. Choose task-specific music, narration, vocals, effects, ambience, or silence; honor supplied assets and user choices. Keep speech clear, avoid clipping or competing vocals, and synchronize picture and sound. Audio assets must be authorized.
assetRequirements: Precompute pigment layers, paper textures, and reveal masks; composite reproducible washes and edge effects. Prepare local assets, load fonts, seed randomness, and cache stateful work. No mandatory audio or source imagery is specified.
combinations: Often works alone. With style-097, use washes as restrained chart fills while keeping axes, labels, value boundaries, and encodings crisp. With style-024, add one handwriting-style annotation voice in #3C4E58 on retained paper. Do not overcrowd or add ink colors.
productionApproach: Use Canvas 2D for deterministic drawing; Python and Pillow can preprocess and composite assets. HyperFrames is the primary composition, timing, sync, validation, and export pipeline; Remotion only if unavailable or a verified required capability is blocked, with reason recorded. GSAP can provide a paused seekable timeline. Keep visual construction and motion ownership in specialist layers; select only needed tools. For HTML, scroll may drive interaction; video must use composition time, not live input.
